in_marathi.name: Paresh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of all beings
in_marathi.long_meaning: Paresh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Paresh is a Sanskrit name that derives from the term 'Para-ishwar', meaning 'Lord of all beings'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with the supreme deity, Lord Shiva.

vedic_reference.note: Derived from the Sanskrit word परिशत् (parishat), meaning 'army, retinue', which can also be interpreted as 'those who are near (to the king) and obey his commands'. The name Paresh can thus be seen as a reflection of the power and authority of a king or ruler.
